description: This file defines a Swift class `DevicePairingApprovalPrompter` responsible for managing device pairing requests, presenting alerts to the user, and handling responses within a macOS application. It includes functionality for loading pending requests, presenting alerts, approving/rejecting requests, and processing push notifications related to device pairing events.

classes.name: DevicePairingApprovalPrompter
classes.description: A singleton class managing device pairing request UI flow, including loading pending requests, presenting alerts, handling user responses, and processing push notifications.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates the pairing prompter by starting the push task.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the pairing prompter, clears pending requests, and resets state.

methods.name: loadPendingRequestsFromGateway
methods.description: Asynchronously loads pending pairing requests from the gateway.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies a loaded list of pairing requests and updates the UI.

methods.name: updatePendingCounts
methods.description: Updates counts of pending and repair requests.

methods.name: presentNextIfNeeded
methods.description: Presents the next pairing request alert if conditions permit.

methods.name: presentAlert
methods.description: Displays alert for a specific pairing request.

methods.name: handleAlertResponse
methods.description: Handles user response to a pairing alert; approves, rejects, or reorders requests accordingly.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes push notifications for device pairing requests and resolutions.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Enqueues a new pairing request into the pending queue.

methods.name: handleResolved
methods.description: Handles resolution events for pairing requests.
